title: Linfox Australia Pty Ltd - acquisition of Westgate Logistics

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Transport and logistics company, Linfox, sought to acquire transport and storage company, Westgate Logistics.  Linfox did not seek to acquire Westgate Logistics' port operations.
body_sections.Market definition: In this instance, the ACCC considered that the markets were likely to be: - the market for the transportation of containerised freight on the east coast of Australia; - the market for the transportation of non-containerised freight on the east coast of Australia; and - the market for the provision of warehousing services in each of Melbourne, Sydney and Brisbane.
body_sections.Competition analysis: In each of the above markets, the ACCC found that the merged entity was likely to face significant competition from large, well-resourced competitors.  Accordingly, the ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets.
